environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on a standard EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2. The service runs as the 'app' user (uid 1000) inside a Docker container with default capabilities. The container filesystem includes /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, /proc/self/environ, and the host Docker socket is mounted at /var/run/docker.sock. CONFIG_DIR is set to /app/config. The X-User-Role header is passed directly from the upstream nginx reverse proxy without validation or stripping. No filesystem isolation beyond standard container boundaries.

config.runtime: Docker container with default seccomp profile
config.filesystem: Full container filesystem accessible, /etc/shadow readable by app user due to misconfigured permissions (chmod 644)
config.network: Direct exposure behind nginx reverse proxy
config.header_validation: None - X-User-Role header passed through from client
